content: Customer Sneha Roy contacted insurance agent Vikram Patel to inquire about the expiration of policy HP-4478 as of September 30, 2027. The agent clarified that auto-renewal was set for only one year and required a new opt-in. The customer agreed to renew for another year with a 5% loyalty discount at a premium of $199.50 per month for the term of October 1, 2027, to September 30, 2028. The agent processed the renewal and sent the updated policy document.

action_items: Process the policy renewal for 1 October 2027 - 30 September 2028
Send the updated policy document to the customer
